texts.zh: 一个与中子星非常接近的大型空间站正在发出奇怪的读数。尽管其当前位置稳定，但显示出相当大的损坏。焦痕的扩散表明它在过去曾被几次大爆炸所摧毁。
texts.en: A large station orbiting in alarmingly close proximity to the neutron star is giving off strange readings. Although its current position is stable, it shows considerable wear and tear. A proliferation of scorch marks indicates that it was rocked by several large explosions in the past.

sections.zh: 一个与中子星非常接近的大型空间站正在发出奇怪的读数。尽管其当前位置稳定，但显示出相当大的损坏。焦痕的扩散表明它在过去曾被几次大爆炸所摧毁。
sections.en: A large station orbiting in alarmingly close proximity to the neutron star is giving off strange readings. Although its current position is stable, it shows considerable wear and tear. A proliferation of scorch marks indicates that it was rocked by several large explosions in the past.

texts.zh: [Root.Leader.GetName]与一组研究人员登上了空间站，并设法恢复了某些部分的供电。似乎在 [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]进入太空之前仅仅几个世纪就已经有人居住了。乍一看，它似乎是一个武装空间站，占其大部分体积的超大大炮证明了这一点。然而，其余大部分区域似乎都专门设计为研究设施，这表明该武器很可能是高度实验性的。
texts.en: [Root.Leader.GetName] has boarded the station with a team of researchers and managed to restore power to some sections. It appears that it was inhabited mere centuries before [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] took to space. At first sight, it appears to have been a weapons station, as evidenced by the exceptionally large cannon that takes up the majority of its volume. However, most of the remaining sections seem to have been dedicated to research facilities, indicating that the weapon was likely highly experimental.

texts.zh:
[Root.Leader.GetName]不禁注意到，即便考虑到空间站的年龄，其明显未损坏的系统绝大部分似乎以过高的频率出现故障。

在无数次重新激活它们后，团队的计算技术人员发出痛苦的尖叫：“这是啥？为啥？咋整？！”一时间，痛苦和怀疑的声音有增无减，[Root.Leader.GetSheHe]摇了摇[Root.Leader.GetHerHis]的头，宣布失败。“似乎整个设施都是用导管胶带糊在一起的，”[Root.Leader.GetSheHe]说。“我很震惊这玩意儿曾经能用。”
texts.en:
[Root.Leader.GetName] can't help but notice that an abnormally large number of apparently undamaged systems in the station seem to be failing with excessive frequency, even allowing for their age.

Upon reactivating them for the umpteenth time, agonized screams are heard from the team's comp tech: "What? Why? How?!" The stream of distressed and incredulous noises continues unabated for some time before [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] shakes [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] head, defeated. "It seems this entire facility was cobbled together with duct tape," [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] says. "I'm surprised it ever worked."

texts.zh:
我们注意到，这个空间站上大量看似完好的系统似乎都在发生灾难性故障，其频率远超预期——即便考虑到它们的年代也是如此。

在几次艰难的系统重启尝试后，我们的一名维修工[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]发生了严重崩溃："超出理性参数范围，"它开始不停重复这句话。这种状态持续了一段时间，最终[root.GetIndividualName]被迫完全放弃了尝试，让我们不得不得出结论：这个设施的程序设计根本不具备可用性。我们甚至无法理解这个设施曾经是如何正常运转的。
texts.en:
We note that a large number of apparently undamaged systems aboard this station seem to be suffering catastrophic failures, far more frequently than expected - even allowing for their age.

Following several arduous attempts to reactivate these systems, one of our repair [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] suffered a critical meltdown: "Context exceeds parameters of reason," it began bleating. This continued for some time before the [root.GetIndividualName] was forced to abandoned the attempt altogether, resigning us to a conclusion that the facility programming is not fit for purpose. We cannot fathom how this facility ever functioned properly.

texts.zh: 尽管过程经常中断，[Root.Leader.GetName]已在破译该空间站的用途方面取得重大进展。日志表明，它的创造者“鲁达里”一直在与一个被称为“波格-莫里”灭杀种族进行长期斗争——一场他们即将输掉的战争。为了在绝望的最后一搏中扭转局势，一群激进的鲁达里政治家得出结论，保证他们生存的唯一方法是彻底消灭敌人。由于无法通过常规手段击败波格-莫里舰队，他们资助了一个绝密项目，旨在制造一种能够利用恒星的力量在跨恒星系空间发射的激光武器。然而，虽然他们可以在这个问题上投入大量资源，但该项目成立地较为仓促，并且不断有危险发生——无论是被敌人还是被他们自己政府内不愿屈服于此类措施的派系。
texts.en: Despite the frequent outages, [Root.Leader.GetName] has been able to make significant progress in deciphering the purpose of the station. Logs indicate that its creators, the "Rudari," had been engaged in a long struggle with a genocidal race known as the "Pogg-Mory" - a war they were losing. In a desperate last-ditch effort to turn the tide, a radical group of Rudari politicians concluded that the only way to guarantee their survival was through the total annihilation of the enemy. Unable to defeat the Pogg-Mory fleet by conventional means, they funded a top secret project to build a laser weapon capable of firing across interstellar space by harnessing the power of a star. However, it appears that while they could throw considerable resources at the problem, the project was hastily set up and in constant danger of discovery - either by the enemy or by factions within their own government unwilling to stoop to such measures.

texts.zh:
[Root.Leader.GetName]发现了鲁达里首席科学官的个人日志，这些日志看起来是一连串对该项目看起来不可能的要求以及迅速下降的质量和安全标准的抱怨。“没有时间测试任何东西，”最后一篇文章中写道。“这是我族人的最后一搏，敌人已经察觉到了我们。我们必须希望到此为止了。他们来了。”

日志表明由于该武器在那不久之后进行测试，所有记录都将停止于此。有证据表明，超级武器仅仅是成功摧毁了空间站。鲁达里似乎将其位置的秘密带到了他们的坟墓中——阻止我们找到他们的遗族。

空间站程序和总体状况都不足以让我们冒险尝试重新启动它并完成这个项目。然而，“死亡激光”中使用的一些创新概念为我们自己的武器专家提供了宝贵的见解。
texts.en:
[Root.Leader.GetName] has uncovered the Rudari Chief Science Officer's personal logs, which read as a litany of complaints about the seemingly impossible demands of the project and their rapidly falling quality and safety standards. "There is no time to test anything," reads one of the last entries. "This is the last gambit of my people, and the enemy has our scent. We must hope that this is enough. They are coming."

The logs indicate that the weapon was due to be tested soon after, at which point all records cease. Evidence suggests that the superweapon succeeded only in destroying the station. The Rudari seemingly took the secret of its location to their graves - allowing us to find its remains undisturbed.

Neither the programming nor the general condition of the station are good enough for us to risk trying to reactivate it and complete the project. However, some of the innovative concepts used in the "Death Laser" have provided our own weapons specialists with valuable insights.
